statement: The proposed temporal relevance framework overlaps significantly with arxiv:2605.17639 in focusing on temporal degradation in legal/statutory texts and acknowledging the problem of outdated retrieval signals, but differs in goal (diagnosing decay vs mitigating it via retrieval-agnostic temporal weighting) and method (analyzing co-citation predictability vs adjusting retriever rankings with temporal relevance).

evidence.quote: Co-citation structure is widely assumed to provide stable retrieval signal in legal information systems. We test this assumption longitudinally by constructing UA-StatuteRetrieval, a benchmark that measures co-citation predictability across 20 annual snapshots (2007-2026) of 396 million codex citations from 101 million Ukrainian court decisions.
